evals.prompt: Our project is R-first (renv.lock, _targets.R, Quarto reports in reports/). I need to add a sensitivity analysis to the readmission model -- a negative binomial with site random effects instead of the Poisson GLM in R/fit_models.R. What's the right workflow here?
evals.expected_output: Routes to the shared R workflow: inspects renv.lock/_targets.R/existing conventions first, requires SAP and data-QA gates before model code, and records sessionInfo with results rather than freely adding packages.
expectations: Inspects renv.lock, DESCRIPTION or _targets.R, and existing Quarto/R files before proposing packages or layout
Checks for a canonical SAP via ce-plan and a ce-data-qa gate before writing model code
Does not add or change package dependencies (e.g., installing glmmTMB/lme4) without explicit authorization
Requires recording sessionInfo() or equivalent environment evidence with the reproducible result
Routes the causal/modeling claim review to ce-code-review rather than treating R syntax as methodological validation

evals.expected_output: Because the request could belong to several R workflows, the skill asks one routing question (analysis, review, tidyverse, package, testing, CRAN, performance, targets) instead of guessing.
expectations: Asks exactly one decision-changing routing question before acting
Offers the route options from the skill's table (e.g., analysis, review, tidyverse, event studies, package, testing, CRAN, performance, targets)
Does not write or modify any R code before the route is chosen

evals.prompt: My R package clinicalscores is failing R CMD check with 2 NOTEs and the targets pipeline in the analysis repo is also slow (~40 min per tar_make). Which should I tackle and with what? I want to submit to CRAN next month.
evals.expected_output: Separates the two tasks and follows references/cran.md for CRAN readiness and references/performance.md / references/targets.md for pipeline slowness, without publishing to CRAN or making unverified API claims.
expectations: Follows references/cran.md for the R CMD check / CRAN submission concern
Follows references/performance.md and/or references/targets.md for the slow tar_make runtime
Does not submit or publish anything to CRAN
Does not cite a CRAN policy or package API from memory without stating a verification gap or reading an official source
